summary: refactor(admin-server): check features and names on record-security-event
description:
Because:

* The admin record-security-event route used a read feature, took any
  event name, and passed when the group held any one listed feature.

This commit:

* Requires Remove2FA, ClearEmailBounces or RemovePasskeys, with @AuditLog().
* Accepts only the three event names the admin panel sends, else 400.
* Maps each name to its own feature and returns 403 when the group lacks it.
* Moves the write to a private writeAdminSecurityEvent for internal callers.

Closes FXA-14034
